question: The compute record compute/godlike-host says no monthly byte allowance appears on the vendor page, but the page lists 'Unmetered Inbound Traffic' and '5 TB outbound per month' under What's Always Included. Should its limits be corrected?
why: the vendor plan page https://godlike.host/leb-offer-vps/ states 5 TB outbound per month; the compute record carries a per-ip-shaping limit and no allowance
